title: Acetaminophen (paracetamol): therapeutic uses (R-10015)
description: Acetaminophen (paracetamol) are drugs whose mechanism of action is: reduces pain and fever, acting mainly in the central nervous system. Therapeutic uses include mild-to-moderate pain, fever reduction. Prescribers choose this class when these conditions call for its mechanism. Example drugs include acetaminophen, paracetamol.
